title: Dissolve
lines: Dissolve, dissolve
I dissolve, dissolve
I don't wanna surface
I forget what I know
Now I don't remember what I used to do
Take me under, pull me deeper

title: Longer Than Light
lines: I couldn't remember the room or the year
I don't remember who lifted the stone
Phosphene burning where nothing had been
The tide took a shadow, the shore kept the glow
Whole years went missing, one window stayed bright
the same disappearing, the same afterglow

title: MAZE
lines: Every turn just pulls me in
You're my maze, you know

title: The Killing Game
lines: a fog that never clears
as we play the killing game
is this how my story ends
the fog might never clear
the game spirals out of hand
to forget the pain that I once knew
when you're playing the killing game

title: The Names the Stars Forget
lines: Half asleep, half awake, out of my mind
I'm a glass of warm water in a temple glow
We are the names that the stars forget
We are the tide, we are the thread
